headline: Bitcoin ETFs bleed $1B for a second straight week as BTC hits a four-month low near $62K.
summary: Two consecutive weeks of $1 billion in Bitcoin ETF outflows have crystallized into a broad crypto selloff — Bitcoin touched a four-month low near $62K during the session, extending a six-week losing streak, while Ethereum fell over 3% and XRP hit its lowest level since late 2024. The Fear & Greed index sits at an extreme 10, deep in fear territory. Privacy coins were the lone bright spot, with Zcash gaining 3.45% as traders rotated into assets seen as hedges against surveillance risk.

winners.name: Zcash
winners.catalyst: Zcash outperformed the broader market amid a flight to privacy assets as macro crypto sentiment deteriorated sharply, with traders rotating into privacy coins like ZEC and XMR as a hedge against regulatory and surveillance concerns — a move amplified by the extreme fear environment gripping the wider market.

losers.name: Avalanche
losers.catalyst: Avalanche was among the hardest-hit major assets as accelerating liquidations and a second consecutive week of $1 billion in Bitcoin ETF outflows deepened the crypto-wide selloff, with risk-off sentiment disproportionately punishing mid-cap layer-1 tokens. No Avalanche-specific catalyst was identified; the decline appears driven by broad market capitulation.

whyItMoved: The proximate driver is institutional money leaving Bitcoin ETFs — $1 billion in net outflows for the second consecutive week, according to The Block. That kind of sustained institutional exit removes a significant source of buying pressure and signals that larger funds are reducing crypto exposure. The downstream effect is a broad selloff: Bitcoin touched a four-month low near $62K during the session, extending what is now a six-week losing streak. Ethereum fell 3.15%, Solana dropped 3.75%, and Dogecoin slid over 5%. XRP fell to its lowest level since November 2024 as capital continued leaving the asset class. Avalanche was the hardest-hit major name, down nearly 8%, with no asset-specific catalyst — the move reflects the broader pattern of mid-cap layer-1 tokens absorbing outsized losses during risk-off episodes. The Fear & Greed index at 10 — deep in Extreme Fear territory — confirms the sentiment picture. The one exception was privacy coins: Zcash gained 3.45% while most of the market fell. Traders appear to have rotated a portion of capital into assets perceived as resistant to regulatory surveillance, a pattern that has appeared in prior periods of macro crypto stress.
worthKnowing: Kava's lending protocol lost roughly $3.8 million to a hack, sending the KAVA token down nearly 40% — adding to negative sentiment around DeFi on an already difficult day.
XRP fell to its lowest level since November 2024 as broad capital outflows hit major altcoins particularly hard, according to CoinDesk.

The UK, Singapore, and Thailand central banks are piloting cross-border foreign exchange settlement infrastructure using stablecoin and tokenization technology, signaling growing institutional interest in the underlying rails even as crypto markets sell off.
